reviewLimitations: AI-only diagnostic assessment, not a qualified human review or release-readiness finding. Source-only annotation subjects have no candidate, so candidate judgments are null. Repeated raw/parsed/rejected/delivered strings are the same textual evidence, not independent linguistic observations. No underlying real sign or email was provided to verify literal content; no external validation performed. Candidate-level local repairs do not imply delivery or overall passage success. completeCoverage concerns only Batch 04, not parent experiment.
